\paragraph{Operating constraints and evidence.} 
% Shared source: ANT-SYS-FR-001
The system feasibility assessment must identify a common mass, epoch, orbit/RAAN, duty-cycle, response and resource baseline for each combined margin and disclose incompatible evidence rather than pool it. Studies retain distinct epoch, mass and detector-response assumptions; no combined margin is inferred.

\paragraph{Feasibility assessment.} The evidence supports scenario-level operations and resource feasibility. Each study retains its own configuration; the integrated mission conclusion in Section 5 distinguishes demonstrated results, conditional applications and unassessed constraints.
